title: SynthDataGen
summary: A tabular synthetic-data pipeline that generates data primarily via a CART-based adaptive sampler, evaluates synthetic quality against real data, and benchmarks augmented classification/regression performance across multiple imputation strategies. It also runs SDV's GaussianCopula, CTGAN, CopulaGAN, and TVAE synthesizers in sdv_all.py as alternative generation methods for comparison.
